title: Reviewed wave C routing (Claude continuation, 2026-11-05)
description: Routing corrections from the model review of the DeepSeek ROS wave C (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human). They change the family, strategy or role of a card whose package showed another shape; they do not change source pins, package status, signatures or publication.

overrides.justification: Model review of wave C: skip, a ROS 2 launch environment for multi-drone Gazebo plus ArduPilot SITL whose only control code is a pymavlink Tk GUI; the vehicles fly through ArduPilot SITL, the gh.ardupilot/ardupilot card.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the clone is a description and asset repository (USD, URDF, MJCF) with no ROS node, topic, service or action; the card's models[0] piper_description.xml is the served MJCF.

Model review of wave C: UR5TaskSpaceEnv is a gymnasium.Env (ur5_task_space.py:17) served by reset/step, so GymnasiumDriver; it drives whatever UR controller ROS runs, and UR5PickAndPlaceRealEnv is out of scope.

Model review of wave C: FlightEnvVec (flight_env_vec.py:20) is a Gymnasium env over the compiled flightgym VecEnv, served by reset/step/seed as for gh.uzh-rpg/flightmare; flightros holds Unity and ROS demos, not the RL interface.

Model review of wave C: skip, prior art: a real-Franka assembly baseline over the external panda_ros_interface (core/action_interface.py:16, 56) with no simulator or stop; it does not run as shipped (main.py:13).
Model review of wave C: skip, as gh.khancyr/ardupilot_gazebo, which this plugin replaces (README.md:7-9): a C++ Gazebo Sim plugin library for ArduPilot SITL over UDP with no ROS or Python API.
Model review of wave C: licence conflict (GPL-3.0-or-later ArduPilot files compiled into an Apache-2.0-carded plugin); routing unchanged; the owner decides publication.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the card's models are the shipped MJCF scenes; the configured small_warehouse.xml (mujoco_ros2_control.xacro:7) steps in MuJoCo and the clone implements no ROS node.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the card's only model is the MJCF humanoid_legged_control_.xml, which humanoid_sim.py steps with mj_step; its ROS 2 node only carries target and state topics.
Model review of wave C: the hardware-free scope is PBController in ROSWorld(sim_only=True) (plan_tools/ros_world.py:35-38); ROSController is the retired real-PR2 ROS path with no acknowledged stop.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the card's first model is the MJCF scene_crl.xml, which the repository's G1 simulator loads with mj_loadXML; its ROS 2 graph carries controller and monitor traffic.
Model review of wave C: licence conflict (GPL-2.0 LICENSE but BSD 3-Clause package.xml); routing unchanged; the owner decides publication.

Model review of wave C: skip, a Gazebo scenario composition: launch files, worlds and a Husky xacro wiring external control and navigation packages (README.md:11-16); no command, step or stop endpoint in the clone.

Model review of wave C: GazeboCartPole-v0 is a gymnasium.Env (gym_env.py:49) that steps an in-process gz-sim world in lockstep; the repository's ROS 2 packages only wrap it, so GymnasiumDriver, not RosDriver.

Model review of wave C: skip, not a device: gz-sensors is the C++ Gazebo sensor-model library over gz-transport (README.md:18-20, package.xml:26-28); it ships no ROS endpoint and needs a host simulator.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the card's models and world.* candidates are the vendored Unitree MJCF scenes; the package steps the B2 scene (b2_description_mujoco/xml/scene.xml) with mj_step.

Model review of wave C: UnscrewingEnv is a legacy gym.Env (unscrewing_env.py:14) registered as gym_unscrewing_env-v0 and served by reset/step; its ROS topics and /reset_robot calls are internal, so GymnasiumDriver.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the VLM launch's default scene go2_gazebo_sim/mujoco/vlm_exploration_scene.xml (single_vlm_mujoco_far.launch.py:142-146) is an MJCF that mujoco_ros2_control steps.
Model review of wave C: licence conflict (MIT LICENSE but Apache-2.0 package.xml); routing unchanged; the owner decides publication.

Model review of wave C: skip, not a device: the pin is an unmodified ROS 2 robot-package template (README.md:1-3) with one empty base_link and only robot_state_publisher; no sensor, Gazebo launch or bridge exists.

Model review of wave C: NavGym-v0 is a legacy gym.Env (env.py:30) served by reset/step and the nav_gym_ros nodes only wrap it, so GymnasiumDriver; CrowdSim-v0 needs configure() before reset and is out of scope.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the clone is a description repository (URDF, MJCF, USD) with no ROS node, topic, service or action; the card's models[0] HU_D03_03.xml is the served MJCF.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the clone is a robot description collection whose ROS files only display, spawn or visualise models; the card's models[0] go_bdx/scene.xml is an MJCF scene with 16 position actuators.
Model review of wave C: QuadcopterTrackingEnv is a gym.Env (train_sac.py:50) served by reset/step; its ROS 2 topics and gz-transport calls are internal, so GymnasiumDriver; no gym.register id exists.
Model review of wave C: licence conflict (GPL-3.0 LICENSE, Apache-2.0 source headers and a TODO package.xml); routing unchanged; the owner decides publication.

Model review of wave C: the node's ROS surface has only topics; the package binds the BlueboatROSInterface class (ros2_blueboat_interface.py:34), whose MAVLink calls carry arm, disarm and thrust, as a direct Driver.

Model review of wave C: as gh.micro-ros/micro_ros_arduino, this is the firmware-side micro-ROS client and transport stack for Zephyr (README.md:4) with only an Int32 demo publisher, not a device driver.

Model review of wave C: a direct Driver over scripts.adam:ADAM, not RosDriver: ADAMSim is a PyBullet Python simulator; its ROS layer (scripts/ros_connection.py) is a bridge to the real ADAM robot, not a simulator control node.

Model review of wave C: skip, framework: UniROS ships only MultiROS/RealROS base classes and copy-me templates whose hooks raise NotImplementedError; the concrete environments live in rl_environments (docs/envs/index.rst:4-9).

Model review of wave C: skip, a MATLAB/Simulink SIL example that connects a modified PX4 submodule to Simulink plant models (README.md:18); no Python, ROS or callable API; PX4 itself is the gh.px4/px4-autopilot card.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the card's only model is the MJCF humanoid_legged.xml, which the repository's own humanoid_sim.py steps with mj_step; ROS carries only the controller loop.

Model review of wave C: skip, the PX4 Gazebo Classic plugin suite for MAVLink SITL and HITL with no dependency on ROS (README.md:1-12); vehicles fly through PX4 over MAVLink, the gh.px4/px4-autopilot card.

Model review of wave C: skip, prior art: Gym envs for a real Franka Panda over franka_ros with no simulator; gym_panda_robot.envs imports a missing panda_reacher_manga (envs/__init__.py:1-2), so no env loads as shipped.

Model review of wave C: RacingBotEnv-v0 is a gymnasium.Env (gazebo_env.py:11) served by reset/step; its /cmd_vel, /odom and laser topics are internal transport, so GymnasiumDriver over a free-running Gazebo.
Model review of wave C: a direct Driver over pyrobosim.core.world:World, not RosDriver: PyRoboSim is a Python 2D simulator whose ROS 2 interface is an optional wrapper (docs/source/index.rst:6).
Model review of wave C: licence conflict (GPL-3.0 repository with "Proprietary and Confidential" helper files); routing unchanged; the owner decides publication.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the clone has no ROS endpoint; the card's model sandbox/robots/humanoid.xml is DeepMind's MuJoCo Humanoid, which the sandbox steps with mj_step (sim_utils.py:253-279).

Model review after MUJOCO-UNBOUNDED-ACTUATORS: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: device plan world.sim; the dual-arm launch passes franka_description/mujoco/franka/dual_scene.xml to the MuJoCo server (mujoco_ros_pkgs submodule not at the pin).

Model review of wave C: skip, not a device: Tesseract is a ROS-agnostic motion-planning library (README.md:25); its ROS integration lives in the separate tesseract_ros and tesseract_ros2 repositories.

Model review of wave C: the device interface is the serial SDK class AeroHand (aero_hand.py:53); the ROS 2 node only relays topics to it, and the card's other entry symbols lie in git submodules absent at the pin.

Model review of wave C: skip: a Drake and LCM quadruped simulation script (simulate.py:160-182) with no environment API, ROS node or Drake helper; its only package.xml files belong to the vendored TOWR library and a model description.

Model review of wave C: MujocoDriver, not RosDriver: the clone is a model description package with no ROS command interface; the card's model hand/body-with-soft/mjcf/left.xml is an MJCF with 20 position actuators.

Model review of wave C: skip: FlexAssemblyEnv is an unfinished PyBullet gym scaffold whose constructor never returns (flex_assembly_env.py:76, env_interface.py:125-139), with no action or observation space and its registration disabled.
